headline: Auto-Ontology Gives Enterprise Data Meaning
lede: NVIDIA’s Auto-Ontology maps business concepts to real columns, joins, and reviewed SQL expressions. Its indigo data streams give analytics agents a governed path from natural-language questions to inspectable answers.

headline: Worktrunk Makes Parallel Worktrees Practical
lede: Worktrunk turns Git worktrees into a fast, navigable command-line workspace. Interactive picking, setup hooks, shared caches, and isolated directories let developers run several agent-driven tasks without branch collisions.

headline: Skills Put Engineering Discipline Inside Coding Agents
lede: This curated toolkit gives coding agents reusable procedures for TDD, domain modeling, and requirements alignment. Instead of adding another orchestration layer, it installs explicit checkpoints directly into the agent’s working loop.

headline: Floci Brings AWS Workloads Back Onsite
lede: Floci emulates a broad AWS surface locally, from S3 and DynamoDB to Docker-backed Lambda and ECS workloads. Its compatible endpoint lets teams test familiar SDKs, Terraform, and CDK flows without credentials, cloud spend, or network dependency.

headline: Claude-Mem Gives Coding Agents A Local Past
lede: Claude-Mem captures project observations, summarizes them, and retrieves the relevant history when a new session begins. SQLite storage, hybrid search, citations, and exclusion controls make continuity useful without surrendering every project detail to a hosted service.

headline: Agent Desktop Replaces Pixels With Structure
lede: Agent Desktop exposes native accessibility trees as stable, actionable JSON rather than asking an agent to guess from screenshots. Its Rust core supports observe–act–observe workflows across macOS, Windows, and Linux, with stale-reference checks and explicit error handling.

headline: Spec Kit Draws A Repeatable Path To Software
lede: Spec Kit lays out AI-assisted development as a sequence: constitution, specification, plan, tasks, implementation, and convergence. Markdown artifacts, templates, hooks, and presets turn conversational intent into a documented build plan that teams can inspect and reuse.

headline: PR-Agent Turns Pull Requests Into A Test Bench
lede: PR-Agent runs configurable AI reviews wherever a team works, from GitHub Actions and webhooks to local CLI sessions. Its provider-agnostic setup supports multiple model backends, Git platforms, and commands for reviewing, describing, improving, and questioning changes.

headline: MoneyPrinterTurbo Builds Short Video End To End
lede: Give the system a topic and it can assemble a script, visuals, narration, subtitles, music, and a finished export. A visual-first interface spans stock sources, generative models, aspect ratios, batch jobs, and publishing targets from one production surface.

headline: gstack Packages A Virtual Engineering Team
lede: gstack turns an AI coding agent into a roster of focused roles covering discovery, architecture, QA, security, documentation, and release work. Its 23 slash commands provide an opinionated operating system for small teams that need broader engineering coverage.
